item.title: Station Narva 2024 announces line-up
item.description: The music and city festival Station Narva returns for its 7th edition and announces the first performers of 2024 edition!

item.title: Summer Sound 2024 - discover who to see
item.description: Let's explore some gems at this year's Summer Sound festival, set on the scenic beach of Liepaja from August 2-3, 2024.

item.title: Electronica duo Pluie de Comètes releases daydreamy song "Looking forward"
item.description: The third and latest track released by the duo Pluie de Comètes carries their signature warm sound, complete with a light touch of nostalgia and a bit of irony.

item.title: Might Delete Later: First Latvian artist to perfrom at Tomorrowland
item.description: Might Delete Later will be the first Latvian to perform at the world-famous Tomorrowland festival in Belgium.

item.title: Dons releases album "Laiks" and invites to his biggest solo concert
item.description: Dons has released his ninth studio album "Laiks" (eng. Time), as well as the album's accompanying single "Bultiņa melnā". Don't miss out on the big concert coming up. Read more...

item.title: Elizabete Gaile shares a new song "Zinu, ka pāries" - uplifting mantra to guide you through hardships
item.description: Latvian singer-songwriter Elizabete Gaile has released a new single "Zinu, ka pāries", which is like mantra that strengthens during hardships.

item.title: Station Narva 2024: festival guide
item.description: Station Narva festival, taking place from September 5-8, 2024, is an exciting cultural and musical event held in Estonia's easternmost city, Narva. This festival uniquely blends music, art, and artistic experiences.

item.title: MARTA releases her first international EP "Wrong Woman"
item.description: “Wrong Woman” explores themes of self-worth, coming of age, and female empowerment with catchy melodies and devilishly funny lyrics.

item.title: [Ex] da Bass declares his love to Malta with a new single
item.description: [Ex] da Bass, DJ and producer from Latvia, has produced an EDM song about Malta - the Mediterranean island he wholeheartedly calls his second home.
